intro: Malaysia moved from tin and rubber to electronics, palm oil and oil and gas, and is now an upper-middle-income country.

chapters.title: Chips and palm oil
text: Penang is a major centre for testing and packaging computer chips. Malaysia is the world's second-biggest producer of palm oil after Indonesia, and also exports oil and liquefied gas through the state company Petronas.
Rubber gloves made in Malaysia are used all over the world.

chapters.title: Growth
text: Tourism, Islamic finance and services have grown. Kuala Lumpur's skyline is one of the most famous in Asia.

keyTerms.meaning: Oil from oil palm fruit, used in food and cosmetics.
